name: gn01 шум: диапазоны по умолчанию, zero_to_one, normalized, сид, частота равна умножению координат
code:
when player_chat {
    if not chat_message_equals("@gn01") {
        end_thread()
    }
    cancel_event()
    gn01_lo, gn01_hi = 9, -9
    gn01_zlo, gn01_zhi = 9, -9
    gn01_vlo, gn01_vhi = 9, -9
    gn01_big = 0
    for gn01_i in 0..299 {
        gn01_x = gn01_i * 3.7
        gn01_z = gn01_i * 1.9
        gn01_p = loc(gn01_x, 64, gn01_z)
        gn01_n = perlin_noise_3d(gn01_p, 77, 0.05)
        gn01_lo = min(gn01_lo, gn01_n)
        gn01_hi = max(gn01_hi, gn01_n)
        gn01_n = perlin_noise_3d(gn01_p, 77, 0.05, range_mode: zero_to_one)
        gn01_zlo = min(gn01_zlo, gn01_n)
        gn01_zhi = max(gn01_zhi, gn01_n)
        gn01_n = voronoi_noise_3d(gn01_p, 77, 0.05)
        gn01_vlo = min(gn01_vlo, gn01_n)
        gn01_vhi = max(gn01_vhi, gn01_n)
        gn01_n = perlin_noise_3d(gn01_p, 77, 0.05, 4, 2, 1, normalized: false)
        gn01_big = max(gn01_big, abs(gn01_n))
        if remainder(gn01_i, 50) == 0 {
            wait(1)
        }
    }
    send_message("gn01 значения перлин ${gn01_lo} ${gn01_hi} от нуля ${gn01_zlo} ${gn01_zhi} вороной ${gn01_vlo} ${gn01_vhi} без нормы ${gn01_big}")
    gn01_ok = gn01_lo < 0 and gn01_lo >= -1 and gn01_hi > 0 and gn01_hi <= 1
    send_message("gn01 перлин по умолчанию минус-один-один ${gn01_ok}")
    gn01_ok = gn01_zlo >= 0 and gn01_zhi <= 1
    send_message("gn01 zero_to_one ${gn01_ok}")
    gn01_ok = gn01_vlo >= 0 and gn01_vhi <= 1
    send_message("gn01 вороной ноль-один ${gn01_ok}")
    gn01_ok = gn01_big > 1
    send_message("gn01 без нормы больше единицы ${gn01_ok}")
    gn01_q = loc(12.3, 64, 40.7)
    gn01_a = perlin_noise_3d(gn01_q, 5, 0.05)
    gn01_b = perlin_noise_3d(gn01_q, 5, 0.05)
    gn01_c = perlin_noise_3d(gn01_q, 6, 0.05)
    gn01_ok = gn01_a == gn01_b and gn01_a != gn01_c
    send_message("gn01 сид повторяется и различает ${gn01_ok}")
    gn01_a = perlin_noise_3d(loc(103, 41, 207), 5, 0.05)
    gn01_b = perlin_noise_3d(loc(5.15, 2.05, 10.35), 5, 1)
    gn01_ok = abs(gn01_a - gn01_b) < 0.001
    send_message("gn01 частота равна умножению ${gn01_ok} ${gn01_a} ${gn01_b}")
    gn01_a = perlin_noise_3d(loc(100, 40, 200), 5, 0.02)
    gn01_b = perlin_noise_3d(loc(101, 40, 200), 5, 0.02)
    gn01_ok = abs(gn01_a - gn01_b) < 0.1
    send_message("gn01 соседи плавно ${gn01_ok}")
}

name: gn05 generate_tree растёт и на стекле, bone_meal_block растит траву
code:
when player_chat {
    if not chat_message_equals("@gn05") {
        end_thread()
    }
    cancel_event()
    gn05_base = shift_coordinate(align_location(value.location, rotation_mode: remove), 8, type: y)
    gn05_good = shift_coordinate(gn05_base, 8, type: x)
    gn05_bad = shift_coordinate(gn05_base, -8, type: x)
    set_block(shift_coordinate(gn05_good, -1, type: y), block(grass_block))
    set_block(shift_coordinate(gn05_bad, -1, type: y), block(glass))
    generate_tree(gn05_good, tree_type: birch)
    generate_tree(gn05_bad, tree_type: birch)
    wait(5)
    gn05_grown = game.block_equals(block(birch_log), gn05_good)
    send_message("gn05 на дёрне выросло ${gn05_grown}")
    gn05_none = game.block_equals(block(air), gn05_bad)
    send_message("gn05 на стекле пусто ${gn05_none}")
    gn05_a = shift_all_coordinates(gn05_base, -14, -2, -9)
    gn05_b = shift_all_coordinates(gn05_base, 22, 16, 9)
    clear_region(gn05_a, gn05_b)
    wait(5)
    gn05_lawn_a = shift_all_coordinates(gn05_base, -2, -1, -2)
    gn05_lawn_b = shift_all_coordinates(gn05_base, 2, -1, 2)
    set_region(block(grass_block), gn05_lawn_a, gn05_lawn_b)
    bone_meal_block(shift_coordinate(gn05_base, -1, type: y), 5)
    wait(5)
    gn05_plants = 0
    on_grid(gn05_p, gn05_lawn_a, gn05_lawn_b) {
        if not game.block_equals(block(air), shift_coordinate(gn05_p, 1, type: y)) {
            gn05_plants += 1
        }
    }
    gn05_ok = gn05_plants >= 1
    send_message("gn05 удобрение вырастило ${gn05_ok} растений ${gn05_plants}")
    clear_region(gn05_a, gn05_b)
    wait(5)
    gn05_gone = game.block_equals(block(air), shift_coordinate(gn05_base, -1, type: y))
    send_message("gn05 убрано ${gn05_gone}")
}

name: gn10 отмена и повтор словарём id_with_data → места
gn11 поворот на 90: вектор вокруг Y, get_block_data у ступеней, новая сторона
code:
func gn11_rotate(gn11_a: location, gn11_b: location, gn11_to: location, gn11_angle: number) {
    on_grid(gn11_p, gn11_a, gn11_b) {
        if not game.block_equals("air", gn11_p) {
            gn11_data = get_block_material(gn11_p, value_type: id_with_data)
            gn11_v = get_vector_between_locations(gn11_a, gn11_p)
            gn11_v = rotate_vector_around_axis(gn11_v, gn11_angle, axis: y)
            if text_contains(gn11_data, "facing=") {
                gn11_old = get_block_data(gn11_p, "facing")
                if gn11_old != "up" and gn11_old != "down" {
                    gn11_face = get_vector_from_block_face(gn11_old)
                    gn11_face = rotate_vector_around_axis(gn11_face, gn11_angle, axis: y)
                    gn11_new = vector_to_direction_name(gn11_face)
                    gn11_data = replace_text(gn11_data, "facing=${gn11_old}", "facing=${gn11_new}")
                }
            }
            set_block(shift_location_on_vector(gn11_to, gn11_v), gn11_data)
        }
    }
}

when player_chat {
    if not chat_message_equals("@gn11") {
        end_thread()
    }
    cancel_event()
    gn11_a = shift_coordinate(align_location(value.location, rotation_mode: remove), 8, type: y)
    gn11_b = shift_coordinate(gn11_a, 3, type: x)
    gn11_to = shift_coordinate(gn11_a, 4, type: y)
    set_block(gn11_a, block(stone))
    gn11_mid = shift_coordinate(gn11_a, 1, type: x)
    set_block(gn11_mid, "oak_stairs[facing=north]")
    set_block(gn11_b, block(glass))
    gn11_seen = get_block_data(gn11_mid, "facing")
    send_message("gn11 данные ступеней ${gn11_seen}")
    gn11_rotate(gn11_a, gn11_b, gn11_to, 90)
    wait(2)
    gn11_vec = rotate_vector_around_axis(vec(3, 0, 0), 90, axis: y)
    gn11_glass_at = shift_location_on_vector(gn11_to, gn11_vec)
    gn11_ok = game.block_equals(block(glass), gn11_glass_at)
    send_message("gn11 стекло на месте ${gn11_ok}")
    gn11_x = get_vector_component(gn11_vec)
    gn11_z = get_vector_component(gn11_vec, vector_component: z)
    send_message("gn11 вектор ${round(gn11_x)} ${round(gn11_z)}")

    gn11_mid2 = shift_location_on_vector(gn11_to, gn11_vec)
    gn11_id = get_block_material(gn11_mid2, value_type: id_with_data)

    clear_region(shift_all_coordinates(gn11_a, -4, 0, -4), shift_all_coordinates(gn11_a, 4, 5, 4))

func gn14_shell(gn14_c: location, gn14_r: number, gn14_block: block) {
    on_grid(gn14_p, shift_all_coordinates(gn14_c, -gn14_r, -gn14_r, -gn14_r), shift_all_coordinates(gn14_c, gn14_r, gn14_r, gn14_r)) {
        if location_is_near(gn14_p, gn14_r + 0.5, gn14_c) and not location_is_near(gn14_p, gn14_r - 0.5, gn14_c) {
            set_block(gn14_p, gn14_block)
        }
    }
}

func gn14_walls(gn14_a: location, gn14_b: location, gn14_block: block) {
    get_all_coordinates(gn14_a, gn14_x1, gn14_y1, gn14_z1)
    get_all_coordinates(gn14_b, gn14_x2, gn14_y2, gn14_z2)
    set_region(gn14_block, gn14_a, loc(gn14_x2, gn14_y2, gn14_z1))
    set_region(gn14_block, loc(gn14_x2, gn14_y1, gn14_z1), gn14_b)
    set_region(gn14_block, gn14_b, loc(gn14_x1, gn14_y1, gn14_z2))
    set_region(gn14_block, loc(gn14_x1, gn14_y2, gn14_z2), gn14_a)
}
